offers.label: Paul Mark Kitchen & Renovations: 'Ballerina Supplier and Installer in the Berkshire Area. Full Design, Planning and CAD Service'. Office in Maidenhead, Berkshire; showroom at Victoria Marble, Ruislip.
'FREE Design Consultation'. This text appears in the Linktree account description, not as a button.

PMK Pods: own-brand outdoor kitchen BBQ pods ('100% 304 Stainless Steel built for harsh weather conditions'). Linktree button 'Home | PMK Pods | Brochure'. The site has a PDF brochure/price list and an order form at pmkpods.com/order-here. Showrooms: Stubbings Nursery, Maidenhead (appointment only) and Earlswood Garden & Landscape Centre.

BlackBull Grill UK: online shop (/shop/) plus an 'ONLINE 3D DESIGN CONFIGURATOR' for modular outdoor kitchens (KitchenBlock, BigQube, HellBoy, PiQoo, Monolith, gas grill module). It lists the same support phone number as Paul Mark Kitchens (01628 632 140).
Business contact on the website: email addresses (paul@ / sales@paulmark.co.uk), phone and a contact form

monetization_evidence.evidence: Kitchen design, supply and fit business: 'Ballerina Supplier and Installer in the Berkshire Area. Full Design, Planning and CAD Service' (Linktree button description). Website: office in Maidenhead and showroom in Ruislip. The Instagram account works as the lead-generation channel for this trade business.

Sells its own product, PMK Pods (outdoor kitchen pods), with an order form and a downloadable price-list brochure. The sister Instagram account @pmkpod (23K followers, 206 posts per embed) posted reel DUNWW5NiL9l: 'Order your PMK Pod Now for delivery June just in time for the World Cup ⚽️⚽️⚽️ #bbq #outdoors #outdoor #bbqpod #outdoorkitchen @pmkpod @paulmarkkitchens @monolithgrillukir @stubbingsnursery ...'.

Runs or is tied to BlackBull Grill UK, an online grill and outdoor-kitchen shop that uses the same phone number (01628 632 140) as paulmark.co.uk. The Linktree bio names 'Black Bull Grill UK'. The 135M-view reel DBKFpVDoZzM caption tags '@paulmarkkitchens @blackbullgrilluk'.
Caption of DHEOd6moA-6: 'Time to start thinking about your outdoor kitchens ready in time for summer. DM me any questions'
Repo embed coding of DBKFpVDoZzM (data/raw/reels/coded_pilot_000.json) records paid_partnership='no'. Brand tags point to the owner's own businesses, not to outside sponsors.

brand_deals_seen: Black Bull Grill UK (@blackbullgrilluk): tagged in the DBKFpVDoZzM caption. blackbullgrill.uk shares Paul Mark's phone number, so this looks like an own or affiliated dealership rather than a third-party sponsorship. The reel has no 'Paid partnership' label (repo coding).

Monolith grill (@monolithgrillukir) and Stubbings Nursery (@stubbingsnursery): tagged on sister account @pmkpod reel DUNWW5NiL9l. They look like a supplier and a showroom partner. Paid status is UNKNOWN.
content_mode_evidence: Repo video coding of DBKFpVDoZzM (data/processed/reels_video_coded.csv) gave production='real_footage', realism='real_existing' and ai_evidence='none'. The first frame is 'A man in a black vest and jeans stands in front of a large wooden wall on a green lawn'; notable: 'The large wooden wall flips up to reveal a fully equipped outdoor kitchen and bar.' A caption says 'Outdoor Kitchen pod that we built'.
niche_focus: UK (Maidenhead, Berkshire) kitchen design-supply-fit firm (Ballerina kitchens). It goes viral with outdoor kitchen / BBQ pod reveal reels and sells its own PMK Pods and BlackBull grills.
cta_pattern: An audience question ('Who would love one of these in their garden?', 'Check out this amazing Outdoor Kitchen pod that we built what do you think?🙌🙌'), plus seasonal urgency and a DM invitation ('Time to start thinking about your outdoor kitchens ready in time for summer. DM me any questions'). Captions tag the owner's own brands (@paulmarkkitchens @blackbullgrilluk) and use product hashtags (#bbq #outdoorcooking #outdoorliving). The sister account uses a hard sell ('Order your PMK Pod Now for delivery June...').
